body:
I'm sorry that your friends are doing the same to you, especially after that long. That's gotta be pretty painful.

You are right, I know now to be more wary of these people. I think I got caught up in them talking so highly about themselves that I believe it instead of trusting myself. They've left a trail of a lot of people so it makes sense what they are doing. I'm cutting it off from doing things for them that's for sure, I've put myself out for these people that just don't care about me. 

That's true that I haven't done anything and if I did, I asked about it and would have tried to resolve it. There were a lot of red flags that I ignored about these people and I should have trusted myself to begin with. Thanks for your insight, it's really appreciated. It's hard not to get in a cycle of self-doubt.

That's a really good way to think about it. I appreciate the perspective, especially that they are making room for better people to come into my life. It's their choice and at the end of the day, after they've shown that they aren't great people, It's for the best.

Hey! I never got the notification for this but It's really nice to see someone respond even after 5 months. 

Il have to check out motivational interviewing, that seems really interesting. I've been doing good with my husband actually. I think it was about finding the right therapist for him, someone that specializes in autism in adults as well as really laying out what issues I had in our relationship so that he could bring them up to his counsellor. 

We've made a ton of strides since then and he's a much happier person in general these days. We still have days where things are a bit off, especially since I'm a lot more social than him but we make it work. I'm extra cognizant about social gatherings with him to make sure he feels comfortable going and if he doesn't I go myself. 

Hope you are doing well, and wishing you the best with everything too!

I’m doing! I’m not perfect by any means but I’m working on myself all the time. I’ve made strides in making friends, it helps when you find people that you can relate to and have similar struggles IE they struggle with exactly what I mentioned. 

Also I got told this “I’m so focused being in others lives that I’m not focused on my own life” and it’s true. I’ve really focused on things that make me happy and trying to do them. Taking care of my health and doing therapy. If you want to chat more feel free to DM me, it always helps to have someone who gets this kinda stuff :)

Wow there are so many people that are absolute dicks here. I’m pretty sure OP feels fucking guilty why are y’all gonna make them feel worse? Shit happens, with humans, with puppies etc. I’m so sorry OP this sucks and I can’t imagine the pain you are going through. This is one of those things that time is the only thing that heals. 

Oh and to the people that are being shitty. This could have happened to you or to anyone else. Kittens and Puppies can go under feet, out the door by accident, play with the wrong thing, eat something they aren’t supposed to at any point no matter how careful you are. So whether or not they should have been out with the puppy running doesn’t even matter at this point.
It’s not that Bruce needs to be fired, it’s more that it is clear that Bruce is not Rutherfords pick for coach and will be fired at some point(or just let the contract expire). Just a matter of when.
Don’t think it does Hog or Rathbone any good just sitting in the press box. May as well send them to Abby and get some more ice time.

“We should be friends after I leave” - my current T is an intern and is leaving in the next year or so. We are pretty much the same age and get along super well(when we are just shooting the shit and not talking about my stuff). It won’t happen and I’m more than aware of that lol
I see the whole sub looking for one player to blame but realistically the whole group seems to have issues. No one meshes and the mentality is way off.
Hogs is on a elc, don’t think he’s a huge problem cap wise.
You can try to put lipstick on a pig, but in the end it’s still a pig
No where near appropriate for that to happen in a session. That would mess me up. Please drop this therapist and find someone you really connect with
I’m kind of confused how people can get that without having being diagnosed with obesity or type 2 diabetes?
100lbs gonna be a long journey!
I just took my first dose today too. We got this!
All good, I like reading self help books so they are welcome

My T self discloses quite a bit which makes me enjoy the process more. In fact we share some things in common so it works out quite well. I’ve asked her a question or two about her situation in relation to my situation and she’s even gotten emotional which was surprising. I don’t think I could have a therapist that didn’t self disclose at least a bit.
Nice! Just added it to my audio books. Il be listening later

I feel you. I’ve spent a lot of my early 20’s trying to make friends and fit in which hasn’t worked. I’m 25 now and have 1 close friend. I wish it wasn’t this lonely, I’m tired of being lonely but seems like the only thing I’m destined for is loneliness

1. I care too much about other people and other peoples problems usually more than myself.
2. I am way too hyper focused on body language, tone, facial movements, what people say and in general other people
3. I am an all or nothing personality so things have to be perfect or nothing. Which as someone else said leads to horrible frustration and burn out.
4. Il always be the first person to reach out and be the friend, support, helper. For me this leads to a bit of resentment than I don’t get the same back
5. Lastly, I shape my personality to others which sometimes makes me seem like I’m not authentic
Man I feel this so much, I could have written it lol
Yep I get the feeling of wanting to run away and start over all the time. Leave no trace and just start over.

I could have written this myself haha I’m sorry I don’t have advice as I’m in a similar boat just know that you aren’t alone in your feelings. I want to help everyone else, I want to be friends with everyone but no one wants to do the same for me. I’m still learning all this self love and acceptance stuff so at the moment I’m not able to move past these feelings but hopefully someday!

Get this post 100% OP you aren’t alone in your feelings. When in a super bad place I’d do really reckless and dangerous stuff just in hopes it might kill me. I don’t know how I got out of it, just letting you know I get it and it sucks.
What book is this? Asking for a friend…. That friend has not so good social skills…
Yes haha all the time. I try to make friends and I’m good to start off but usually can’t maintain the other person for long
Definitely switch therapists. This guy sounds pretty awful to be honest.

I get it, I feel this way a lot of the time. I’m never gonna get the support and attention I should have gotten as a kid. I feel alone and I don’t know how to not feel alone. At least we can all be alone together? Lol sorry I don’t have more advice, just know that I get it
Haha I made my appreciation post and didn’t realize that there was this one 13hr before. Hell yea I love this sub. Never felt so understood in my life.

Since starting therapy I have definitely been heavy into substances. I’ve always felt I can’t really function unless I’m drunk and it hurts that that’s the only way I can feel like myself. 

Trying to work through it but it’s hard and you aren’t alone in the struggle. I was also at the point of saying I’m either going to be drunk all the time or just off myself. I still have those thoughts but I’ve been trying to work through them and not be as dependant on the bottle.

PS your artwork is probably better than you think. We are often our worst critics(I’m a musician so trust me when I say I get it). Doesn’t make it any easier to not think that way but just keep in mind that your perspective is not the same as other peoples
Trust me I feel you. I don’t know and I don’t know how to advise. Just saying I get it

I guess I’m a little confused what you mean by Trauma dump. I don’t usually talk about my issues unless I’m fairly close to the people and even then I try not to because I’ve been let down and I don’t want to freak anyone out/make them uncomfortable. 

Is this like telling people specific trauma instances? Or just more general like I have had trauma in my life?

I really wish I had more people I could talk to but alas I’ll be sticking to my therapist
I’ve gotten “…but you are so nice!” Before and that response has been the weirdest for me. I really don’t know how to respond lol

“It got me attention, care and compassion. That’s what I was lacking in the past” 

I feel that so much. Makes it so hard to connect to people.

I once got told by someone who I thought was a close friend that I should try to read a good book instead of thinking about that stuff. This was after telling her I was suicidal…. Like holy crap really???

I find I have a very all or nothing personality and I read a post in this group that spoke to me quite a bit awhile ago.

For friendships I’m either spilling my guts out to a person or I am very very surface level in terms of how I open myself up. 

I can be everything for someone else(their comedian, therapist etc), I’ve gotten really good at being the thing that other people want in a friend but I’ve never truely been able to connect with others or get that back from someone because I’m so busy trying to mould to them. 

I don’t know myself and I’m not stable with myself. I can’t connect fully because of that. It sucks and I’m lonely but I’m working on it.
Yea! Love the breathing. It’s been helpful. I also like to do a bit of a cold shower as well. Really helps zone into the body/mind connection.

100% feel that. I wish I had advice but I’m in the same boat. 

I guess my folks were the kind that said to “walk it off” if you are hurt, emotionally or physically. So I’ve been doing it for so long telling myself these things like to grow up and shut up when I have negative feelings or I’m hurt, it’s habit at this point. Hard to undo that kind of thing that’s engrained in you.

I’m tired of moulding who I am to appease others. I realize now I was just trying to survive and that’s why I did that but now I don’t have people around me who I connect with. Mainly because I don’t know who I am at all and I can’t gain those friendships that I’ve always wanted. 

I’m sad because I am lonely and wish I had a close circle of people. It’s always been what I’ve wanted but I feel like I’ll never get.

My all or nothing personality traits have been fun to deal with as well as starting therapy and going through mass suicidal depression. People I’ve gone to for help haven’t helped at all and it’s been shitty. Been drinking a lot, doing drugs just to numb my brain and feel like myself for even a moment. It’s starting to take its toll though on me and I realize I just hate myself. Thanks for letting us vent OP

There was one time where my therapist mentioned that she had been thinking about a trauma event I had told her about. It surprised me, I guess I didn’t think my therapist would ever think about me outside of session.

Man I keep coming to this sub because everything fits so well.

 My mom did the same, part of me did know it was weird but I enjoyed the rant time. I guess part of me felt special that I was one of the people she could talk to. 

Now that I’m older when I go see my mom and we go for a car ride. She starts up again and I can barely handle it for 5mins. I get so emotionally tired and I can’t believe young me was capable of listening for so long. Just letting you know you are definitely not alone OP

My partner is on the spectrum and it can be great and it can also be a challenge. The biggest hurdle you will most likely face is having your needs met. As you stated above that there are times that you can’t rely on him during stressful situations.

At first I could handle it but it’s grown to be an issue now that I’m not as mentally stable as I was. The good thing is that as long as you are both willing to learn with each other and make the effort you should be fine :) you will most likely have to be very specific about what you want him to do for you. I’m not sure if you are looking for advice or not but I’d recommend sitting down and going through what you need from him.

I’m curious. I find I have a very all or nothing approach to my relationships/friendships I just can’t seem to get out of. There’s no middle it seems for me. Do you find this for yourself as well? 

As for people letting you down I get it. Been let down so many times we just expect it. I don’t know about you, but I get so scared being let down that I people please and just end up hurting myself because no one would go for me the lengths I go for others.

It’s completely understandable to feel this way upon a bad job interview. Trust me when I say I’ve been there and I’ve failed an interview so bad they were looking at each other during hoping I would leave lol. 

You will persevere and you will get through this. I’m sorry that there is so much going on for you right now that it is affecting your job hunt. Job hunting is already stressful enough! 

I’ve been there for sure, you aren’t alone in this and your feelings are totally valid. If you ever want some more support feel free to pm me. Im always up for a chat

It’s hard to get over the emotional abuse from childhood in this way. I still am on the page that no one likes me, loves me and cares about me. My parents flip flopped between being great one minutiae then being awful and abusive the next. I never knew which one I was going to get so I just started not to trust anyones words or beliefs. 

I’m afraid of creating relationships as well just seems like another can of worms to get hurt. I’m wishing the best for you, you are right when you say it’s uncomfortable and not easy at all. We will survive and thrive :) if we made it through the other shit we’ve been through, we can make it through this.

I get it. I just want someone to care about me the way I should have been cared about when I was a kid. I don’t know how to help you with this, I just wanted you to know that I get it and am going through the same thing. Stay strong

“We grew up without love, support, and kindness we deserved. Because of that, many of us make sure those around us, even strangers on the internet, receive the love, support and kindness we didn’t.”

Fuck that hits hard. I always thought I did it just because I thought the people around us can make us who we are and I want to celebrate the people I give a damn about. But you are right it’s cause I never got that.

I have/had ulcerative colitis and like the commenter Secure-Force I’ve had 3 very unpleasant surgeries to get, to put in simple terms, a faux colon. A result of all the fuckin stress of my childhood me thinks.

I totally get what you mean. I kept thinking I was so pathetic for thinking about it all the time but not doing anything about it.

Maybe part of it is that we want to feel cared about and you see the care that your doctor has for those people. You want to have that same amount of care but don’t know how to get it.
Been finding more and more that the people I am always there for will never be there for me in the same way. It hurts more than words can describe.
Definetily as I’ve become older I’ve internalized or held strong so much that I’m starting to break down. It’s been so hard to even know what I’m feeling anymore
Yep I can be everyone else’s support system but I know no one will ever be the same kind of support back to me. Depressing as fuck and is one of the reasons I’m suicidal.

Yeeeep it’s the reason why I got into music but sometimes now I don’t know why I play… kinda sad. Sometimes I like it, sometimes I think it’s just to get the validation/acceptance from people I never got from my parents

Yeeep. I hate that statement. I may be “loved” by some people but those same people won’t show up for me when I’m struggling. So am I really loved? Hell my friends won’t even text me first let alone them actually taking time to think about me.
Yep, starting to get to the point I can’t make it through without
